+## What
+Add the source guard tests of plan.md §15, copied in method from `../FoundationModelsSkills/Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/`. They scan each line of `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/`.
+
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/Support/SwiftSourceScan.swift`: copy the helper of Skills (walk the Swift files; fail when the walk finds no file).

+- `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/NoDotfolderStackExtensionTests.swift`: no `extension DotfolderStack` and no extension of a type of Extras.
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/NoCodeModeConformanceTests.swift`: no `OperationDescribing` and no `ForkableTool` in the library (plan.md §9.5).
+
+`ReadmeExampleTests` is part of the documentation task, not this task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Each guard test passes on the scaffold.
+- [ ] Each guard test fails when a forbidden line is put into a temporary file under the scanned folder (proved by a test of the scanner on an in-memory list of lines).
+- [ ] An unused exemption in `LoadingBoundaryTests` fails.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The four test files above, plus `SwiftSourceScanTests.swift` for the scanner.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "LoadingBoundary|NoStandardOut|NoDotfolderStack|NoCodeMode|SwiftSourceScan"`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
